note: Stinger (Seibu Denshi 1983) graphics and palette ROMs, MAME set 'stinger' (seibu/wiz.cpp). Paths relative to this spec.

gfx1.note: MAME region gfx1 (0x6000): plane files at 0x0000 (bit 0), 0x2000 (bit 1), 0x4000 (bit 2). Tiles: layer 1 (foreground, D000) banks 0/1 = gfxdecode 0/1; sprites: set 1 (D840) = gfxdecode 4

gfx2.note: MAME region gfx2: tiles: layer 0 (background, E000) banks 0/1 = gfxdecode 2/3; sprites: set 0 (E840) = gfxdecode 5

proms.note: 3 x 256x4, one per gun; resistors 1k/470/220/100 ohm (bit 0..3), pulldown 470 (MAME wiz_state::palette)
